method: Eleventh lunch pass - Los Gatos / Los Altos-adjacent / Palo Alto / Menlo Park / Campbell / Santa Clara rows screened from the first candidate sweep. Every field below was transcribed from a page actually retrieved this turn (URL in the row). Nothing was typed from memory. Where a business publishes two different hours blocks on its own site, both are printed in the flags and nothing is averaged. Yelp business pages return HTTP 403 to direct fetch here, so Yelp facts come from the Yelp business-page URL as surfaced by search and are levelled 'listing'/'conflicting', never 'official'.
